source.name: Buffalo Bills: 'The future is bright' | Bills and Highmark announce naming rights deal for New Bills Stadium
source.quote: the franchise has finalized a new naming rights deal with Highmark Blue Cross Blue Shield of Western New York to continue their partnership at the new stadium

note: Arena naming rights: Highmark Stadium. Start date unknown: the record said 2026 (the season it was recorded), its source is from 2023-06-05.
